proposal_contribution.note: PROPOSAL TEXT ONLY - no brain edit made. Two items, both aimed at the run directive's target.

item_1.claim: The measured under-emission is not caution and it is not a missing driver. It is an ARITHMETIC CONSTRUCTION, and the construction is written out verbatim in the g24 blind posteriors: derive a magnitude SCALE S, estimate a sign probability p, and emit p50 = (2p-1) x S. On my own day: S = 450 (from vol_regime n0_net_sigma_20 558 / n0_net_sigma_10 580, half-normal 0.798 sigma, haircut by sqrt(n0_activity_trend 0.902)), p_up displaced 0.50 -> 0.55, so the symmetric part is (0.55-0.45) x 450 = 45, plus an 85 judgment term, committed 130 - against a realized 630. The emission is 0.29 x S BY CONSTRUCTION, not by judgement.
item_1.why_it_produces_exactly_the_measured_res: Take a day that is +S with probability p and -S with probability 1-p, p >= 0.5. Emitting the probability-weighted MEAN m = (2p-1)S gives E|err| = p(S - (2p-1)S) + (1-p)(S + (2p-1)S) = 4p(1-p)S. Emitting the more likely BRANCH m = +S gives E|err| = 2(1-p)S. Emitting zero (the zero_change benchmark) gives E|err| = S. At p = 0.55 those are 0.990S, 0.900S and 1.000S. SO THE (2p-1)S FORM IS BOUNDED ABOVE BY ZERO_CHANGE FOR ALL p, ITS MAXIMUM POSSIBLE IMPROVEMENT ON ZERO_CHANGE IS 1 - 4p(1-p) = 1% AT p=0.55, AND IT IS BEATEN BY THE BRANCH FORM WHENEVER p > 0.5. The g24 blind scored 0.98x zero_change. That is not bad luck and it is not a hard block - it is the formula's own ceiling, hit almost exactly.
item_1.the_repair: Under sum|err| scoring the p50 must be the MODE of the resolved branch, not the mean of an unresolved mixture. Emitting the mean of a bimodal distribution puts the number in the trough between the two modes, where it is wrong by roughly the full scale on every day regardless of which way the day goes. When the sign is genuinely unresolvable (p about 0.5), the honest output is an A-2 NO CALL - NOT (2p-1)S, which is a disguised zero wearing a forecast's clothes. The current form lets an agent emit a near-zero number while sincerely believing it has made a call, and it produces a small emission on a day whose drivers the agent has itself just sized correctly.
item_1.worked_instance_on_my_own_day: My blind derived S = 450 and the g18-g23 Wednesday day-class mean |actual| is 595 - so the blind's SCALE was right and its EMISSION was 0.22x of its own class mean. The refine resolved the sign and emitted 600, error 30 against a blind error of 500. The 470 USD of improvement came from resolving p, not from finding a bigger driver.
item_1.n_and_scope: The ARITHMETIC needs no n. The instance base spans groups: g24 (mean emission 0.29x of realized, under on 8 of 10, and the construction written out explicitly in at least this posterior), g23 0.68x, g22 0.55x, and magnitude.emission_ceiling_check's own corpus measurement across g18-g23 (59 of 60 days emitted |guess| <= 550 while 30 of 60 delivered more). The ratio WORSENS as the construction becomes more explicit, which is what a construction defect looks like and is not what a market regime looks like.
item_1.falsifier: If forward blinds emit the resolved-branch scale on days where p > 0.5 and sum|err| does NOT improve against zero_change, the construction was not the binding constraint and this is wrong. It is also refuted if the measured p on those days turns out to be below 0.5 - i.e. if the sign estimates are actively anti-informative - in which case the problem is the sign channel, not the arithmetic.

item_2.id: magnitude.emission_ceiling_check re-site (the run directive's explicit ask)
item_2.claim: The play's mechanism stands and its trigger does not, and the reason is structural rather than a mis-set threshold: A SELF-CHECK WHOSE TRIGGER IS 'YOUR OWN NUMBER IS BIG' IS SILENT EXACTLY IN THE FAILURE MODE 'ALL YOUR NUMBERS ARE SMALL'. Its trigger (self.guess_day_move_usd >= 450) is keyed on the very quantity the disease suppresses, so the sicker the block, the quieter the check. On g24 it fired 0 of 10 days (block emission max 250, so the bar sat above the entire distribution); on g18-g23 it fired 8 of 60.
item_2.the_re_site: Key it on the RATIO instead of the level: emission_ratio = |emitted p50| / derived_scale, FIRE when <= ~0.5. A derived scale is emitted alongside the p50 on every posterior by construction (mine is 450 in the blind, 521-before-judgment in the refine), so the ratio is always computable and needs no new data. Siting measured: my own blind is 130/450 = 0.29 -> FIRES; the g24 block at 0.29x mean fires block-wide; my refine at 600 against a derived scale of ~600 gives 1.0 -> does NOT fire, which is the correct behaviour. The bar sits at the centre of its own distribution, which is the property flow.big_print_bshare_thin_tape_guard is named in the brain as the positive template for.
